text: また　がんばって　みるわ！

structure.jp: がんばって　みるわ！

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: みる after a て-form verb means 'try doing it and see'. がんばって　みる = 'I'll try my best'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, feminine way of stating something. みるわ = 'I'll give it a try'.
